data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2024 gross claims outstanding were GBP 448.1m. During 2024 the Syndicate recorded a net favourable prior-year reserve movement: the technical provisions note shows a gross reduction in prior year estimates of GBP 45.34m (a c.10.1% release of opening gross claims) driven by favourable claims development and recalibration of IBNR, notably on longer-tail and specialty classes (improvements highlighted for 2021 and 2022).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) taken directly from the 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' line in the technical provisions reconciliation (Note: amounts are presented in the accounts as GBP 000; converted to millions). The report references RITC activity and a prior year RITC (Syndicate 6117) which can distort comparative development; however the movement line used is explicit gross movement. No gross per-LOB prior-year movement amounts are provided, so lob-level amounts are not quantified. Named catastrophe events are mentioned but not quantified at LOB level.
